collection.title: Renault Captur 2013 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Renault Captur 2013 to 2015 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 14" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Captur which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
